description: Acetylene spike detected at 3.8 ppm — active arcing fault in main winding. Emergency shutdown and inspection required.
Oil temperature exceeded 95°C during peak load under summer heat wave. Cooling fans activated.
Partial discharge readings elevated to 320 pC — possible insulation degradation. Enhanced monitoring initiated.
Lightning strike within 2km caused surge. Protection relay tripped. Restored after inspection.
Elevated vibration at 2.2 mm/s — possible loose mounting hardware. Maintenance crew dispatched.
Bus overload condition during grid reconfiguration. Load balanced to adjacent feeders.
Feeder line damage from wind gusts at 85 km/h. 12,000 customers affected. Crew deployed for emergency repair.
